## Discussion

- It seems better to do roofprint -> roof -> footprint instead of roofprint -> footprint -> roof, because it is easier to identify the points to use in the footprint once we have the roof.
  Therefore, I should look into using roofer with my footprints to get roofs that I can use to filter the points I want to use for the footprints.
